name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v5.94: two new fridge complaint reasons with reason-aware alerting. expired_product and cooling_fault join the enum (now six: not_taken, wrong_quantity, returned_but_charged, expired_product, cooling_fault, other); lines stays required. Alerting is now differentiated: cooling_fault is food-safety and raises a CRITICAL alert on a SINGLE report (deduped per 6h) rather than waiting for a cluster; expired_product raises a warning at 2+ in 24h framed as stock rotation; the original charge-accuracy reasons keep the 3+/24h basket-calibration cluster alert. Added a reason-filtered complaint count. Cumulative over v5.93.
